title: Easy Semester
about: A mindset track meant to reinforce a calm and manageable semester.
description: As a full-time student, some semesters become overwhelming. This song was written to reinforce a mindset of balance and confidence as I approach the final stretch of my academic program.
lyrics: Verse 1 — Alignment & Flow
I am aligned with a smooth, easy semester
This semester unfolds effortlessly for me
My classes flow in balanced and supportive ways
Everything lines up to support my success
I am in perfect timing this semester
My academic path is aligning in my favor
This semester works with me, not against me
I move through it calmly and confidently
My semester feels light, clear, and manageable
I am guided through this term with ease
My school life flows in my favor
And I feel supported as I move
Pre-Chorus — Trust & Calm
I am supported by my environment
My academic life feels organized and calm
I feel capable, steady, and clear
This semester is working out for me
Chorus — Workload
I attract a light, manageable workload
I attract weeks with very few assignments
I attract simple, reasonable coursework
My weeks are not overloaded
I attract balanced schedules
Spaced-out exams and quizzes
I attract fair timelines and clear expectations
My workload stays low and reasonable
Verse 2 — Tests & Performance
I attract easy, fair tests
I attract simple, clear assignments
I attract understanding instructors
My schoolwork feels straightforward
I attract exams I’m prepared for
Quizzes that feel easy
I attract success without burnout
I perform well without stress
I retain information easily
I attract good grades with little strain
I stay ahead without pressure
My effort flows naturally
Chorus — Workload
I attract a light, manageable workload
I attract weeks that are easy to handle
I am not overwhelmed by school
My semester stays balanced and clear
I always have enough time
I complete my work quickly and easily
I balance school, work, and rest with ease
And still have time for me
Bridge — Time, Energy & Support
My energy supports my academic life
My semester supports my well-being
I have plenty of free time
Even while classes are running
This semester feels lighter than past ones
I move through it without burnout
I enjoy this semester
And I’m grateful for how easy it feels
Final Section — Completion & Outcome
My final semester supports my life, not strains it
This semester opens doors for me
I am supported all the way through this term
And I finish strong, clear, and steady
This semester unfolds effortlessly
My academic path is aligned
Everything works in my favor
And this term flows by easily in time
